config.title: Write array deduplication in 3 different ways

intro.title: Write array deduplication in 3 different ways
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that removes duplicate values from an array, implementing three distinct approaches. You will learn core programming concepts like iteration, conditional logic, and working with built-in JavaScript objects. The main technologies involved include arrays, loops, the Set object, and array methods like filter() and indexOf(). By the end, you'll understand how to solve the same lesson using different techniques, enhancing your lesson-solving skills in JavaScript.
intro.usecase: Array deduplication is essential in real-world applications where you need to display unique values from user data. For example, in e-commerce dashboards, you might need to show unique product categories from customer purchase histories without duplicates. In form applications, you might need to filter duplicate email addresses from multiple contact lists before sending notifications. Social media platforms use deduplication to ensure users don't see duplicate posts in their feeds from overlapping friend circles. Data visualization tools apply deduplication to clean datasets before generating charts and reports.

objectives: Implement array deduplication using a Set object to remove duplicate values
Construct a deduplication function that utilizes the filter method with indexOf
Apply the reduce method to build a new array containing only unique elements
Manipulate arrays by comparing current elements with accumulated results
Initialize and configure test arrays to validate each deduplication approach
Integrate multiple deduplication methods into a single demonstration script
Control the output by logging both original and deduplicated arrays to the console
